New Controller for GTA 6 on PS5 Announced

A new exclusive controller for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) on PlayStation 5 will be available for purchase next week. The game will feature a morality meter that players can influence. If a player's actions are deemed sufficiently immoral, the game may stop scoring their progress.
